advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Guard the `_build_parent_breadcrumb` ancestor walk against parent-chain cycles (visited-set or bounded depth) so a cyclic/self-parent chain cannot loop forever.
evidence: src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_comments.py:497: `    while ancestor is not None:`
src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_comments.py:502: `        skipped_intervening = True`
src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_comments.py:503: `        ancestor = local_parents.get(ancestor)`

No `visited` set / depth bound guards the loop; `local_parents` is built verbatim from `t.get("parent_id")` (outbound_differ.py:561-563) with no cycle validation, and search for `cycle`/`visited` in both modules returns no protective guard.
advisory.finding: The upward ancestor walk in `_build_parent_breadcrumb` has no visited-set or depth cap; a parent-chain cycle (e.g. self-parent A->A, or A->B->A) in which no ancestor has a bound Jira key makes `ancestor = local_parents.get(ancestor)` cycle forever and never reach `None`, hanging the reconciler pass in an infinite loop.
advisory.suggested_fix: Track visited ancestors: `seen: set = set()` and `while ancestor is not None and ancestor not in seen: seen.add(ancestor); ...` — break out (nearest_key stays None) when a cycle is detected.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Ensure the parent-drift breadcrumb is still evaluated when `_diff_comments` would early-return (no local comments / live-search path), or document that the no-local-comment drifted-leaf case is intentionally uncovered.
evidence: src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_comments.py:635: `        if not local_comments:`
src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_comments.py:636: `            return []`
src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_comments.py:649: `            return []` (no-client live path)
src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_comments.py:668: `            return []` (failed live fetch)
The breadcrumb `mutations.extend(_build_parent_breadcrumb(...))` sits at lines 752-760, after all these returns — a child with zero local comments returns at 636 and never reaches it.
advisory.finding: The breadcrumb is appended only after the snapshot/live-fetch branches, but three early `return` paths in `_diff_comments` bypass it: live-search snapshot with no local comments (line 636), no client (line 649), and a failed live fetch (line 668). A drifted child that legitimately has no local comments, or is only reachable via the live-search shape, therefore never gets a breadcrumb even though its parent field was suppressed.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that round-trips the emitted breadcrumb body through the outbound codec's `to_wire` and back through `_normalize_comment_body`, asserting `PARENT_BREADCRUMB_TAG` still matches, so append-once is proven under ADF encoding.
evidence: src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_comments.py:491: `    if any(PARENT_BREADCRUMB_TAG in body for body in jira_bodies):`
jira_bodies is built via `_normalize_comment_body` (outbound_comments.py:673) which does `adf_to_text` + strip; the tag must survive that decode of a previously ADF-encoded send.

tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_parent_breadcrumb.py:118-124 constructs `existing` as a raw string and passes it through `_snapshot`, never through `codec.to_wire`, so the ADF round-trip survival of the tag is unverified — an ABSENCE of round-trip coverage.
advisory.finding: Append-once dedup depends on `PARENT_BREADCRUMB_TAG` surviving the ADF encode (`to_wire`) then decode (`_normalize_comment_body` -> `adf_to_text`) round-trip in `jira_bodies`, but no test exercises that round-trip: `test_breadcrumb_idempotent_across_ancestor_change` feeds a plaintext body straight into `_snapshot`, never through the codec. If the HTML-comment tag does not survive the Cloud rich-mode ADF round-trip the way RECONCILER_MARKER is assumed to, the append-once guard silently fails and a second breadcrumb is posted each pass.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a discriminating control to test_breadcrumb_echo_safe: feed the breadcrumb body WITHOUT RECONCILER_MARKER and assert exactly one inbound 'add' mutation, so the `inbound == []` absence is anchored to marker suppression.
evidence: assert inbound == [], "the breadcrumb must be suppressed inbound (RECONCILER_MARKER echo)"

inbound_collection_diffs.py:154 `if RECONCILER_MARKER in body_text: continue` — but also returns [] on empty body (line 156 `if not body_text.strip(): continue`) and on absent comment field (line 129-130)
ABSENCE: no control asserting the same body sans RECONCILER_MARKER yields exactly one inbound 'add' mutation, which would anchor that suppression (not some other empty path) is the cause
advisory.finding: test_breadcrumb_echo_safe asserts `inbound == []` (absence-only) with no discriminating control: `_diff_comments_inbound` returns `[]` in several worlds (RECONCILER_MARKER suppression, empty normalized body, absent/malformed comment field). Without feeding the SAME body WITHOUT the marker and asserting one mutation is produced, the test cannot distinguish marker-driven suppression from any other empty-producing path, so it stays green even if the marker check regressed.
scenarios: A future change strips RECONCILER_MARKER handling but the body normalizer independently empties the body; the echo-safe test still passes
advisory.suggested_fix: Before asserting `inbound == []`, assert that `icd._diff_comments_inbound({"comment": {"comments": [{"id": "501", "body": <body with marker stripped>}]}}, {"comments": []})` returns exactly one 'add' mutation, proving the differ WOULD ingest an unmarked body.

evidence: outbound_comments.py:497-503: `while ancestor is not None: key = binding_store.get_jira_key(ancestor) ... ancestor = local_parents.get(ancestor)` with no visited-set / depth guard

advisory.finding: No test exercises a cyclic `local_parents` chain. The upward walk `while ancestor is not None: ... ancestor = local_parents.get(ancestor)` (outbound_comments.py:497-503) never records visited ancestors, so a cycle (e.g. P1->P2->P1) with no bound member loops forever. This concrete hang/failure path is untested.
